shortDescription: Weapon mounts that fire an ordinary ranged weapon from a fixed position with more range and accuracy. One upgrade branch keeps them manned, with gunner skill and cover. The other automates them with mech subcores or an AI persona core. (Concept stage.)
body:
# Mounted Weapons (concept, not started)

## Pitch
A buildable mount that holds a normal ranged weapon item and fires it in place, with more range and accuracy than the weapon has in a pawn's hands. Mounts can also fire weapons that pawns are normally not allowed to equip (Warcaskets from Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates, heavy and mech weapons from The Dead Man's Switch).

## Tech tree (draft)
1. **Basic mount** (early): manned only.
2. At mech subcore tech the tree branches:
   - **Manned branch** (always available): better mounts with more stability (accuracy bonus on top of the gunner, maybe shorter aim time) and more cover for the gunner.
   - **Automated branch** (Biotech only): one separate building per core, each with its own art that looks more advanced as the core improves. The core is part of the building's construction cost.

| Building | Core in cost | Research gate | Skill equivalent | ShootingAccuracyTurret (vanilla pawn curve) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic auto-mount | Basic subcore | BasicMechtech | ~6 | ~0.95 |
| Standard auto-mount | Standard subcore | StandardMechtech | ~10 | ~0.97 |
| High auto-mount | High subcore | HighMechtech | ~14 | ~0.98 |
| Persona auto-mount | AI persona core | HighMechtech + a late research | ~18 | ~0.987 |

Vanilla anchors: the mini-turret is 0.96 ("like level 8 human shooter"); the autocannon is 0.98 ("like level 14"). Starting numbers, not final balance.

### Without Biotech
The whole automated branch is skipped, including the persona tier. Implement it by putting the automated defs (buildings, research) in a folder that LoadFolders.xml loads only with `IfModActive="Ludeon.RimWorld.Biotech"`. Shared C# can stay loaded; it just has no defs to act on.

### Core refund (open question)
Vanilla deconstruction refunds `resourcesFractionWhenDeconstructed` (default 0.5) of each cost, rounded randomly, so a cost of 1 core has a 50% chance to vanish on deconstruct. Plan: always refund the core on deconstruct. Decide what happens when the mount is destroyed in combat (core lost, or dropped damaged/whole).

## Gunner skill (decided: must matter)
- Vanilla: Verse.ShotReport uses ShootingAccuracyTurret whenever the caster isn't a pawn, so a manned turret ignores its operator.
- Plan: Harmony on ShotReport so that a manned mount uses the manning pawn's ShootingAccuracyPawn (skill, sight, manipulation) times a mount stability factor.
- The gunner should gain Shooting XP while firing (check whether vanilla manning grants any).
- Still open: whether aim time and traits (Trigger-happy, Careful shooter) carry over.

## Cover (manned branch)
Vanilla cover comes from fillPercent on a thing next to the target, toward the shooter. A rotatable mount with its interaction cell (where the gunner stands) behind it gives the gunner cover from the front with no code. Upgraded manned mounts raise fillPercent.

## Decided so far
- One building per core for the automated branch (no core slot).
- Without Biotech, skip the automated branch.
- No firing arc in v1; it may be added later.
- Ranged weapons only; leave out single-use launchers and thrown grenades.
- Installing: a button on the mount picks a weapon, then a colonist hauls it over and installs it. The weapon drops when the mount is uninstalled or destroyed.
- Combat Extended is not a target.

## Heavy weapons from other mods (researched)
- VFE Pirates warcasket guns: `VEF.Weapons.HeavyWeapon` mod extension, enforced only when a pawn equips.
- Dead Man's Switch: `Fortified.HeavyEquippableExtension` + `EquippableDef`, enforced only when a pawn equips. Some DMS guns are built into mechs and may never exist as loose items.
- The mount is a building, so neither restriction applies. Soft compat only, with no dependency. Check in-game: warcasket gun rendering (VFECore.ThingWithFloorGraphic, drawSize 1.7) and DMS custom verbs.

## Likely technical shape
- Mount = Building_TurretGun subclass that stores the real weapon Thing (ThingOwner, saved) and uses it as its gun.
- Range bonus: give the mounted weapon's verb a per-instance cloned VerbProperties with a scaled range.
- Manned: CompMannable + the ShotReport Harmony patch. Automated: CompPowerTrader, core in costList, core refund on deconstruct.
- Needs C# + Harmony (for gunner skill). LoadFolders.xml for the Biotech-only folder.
